description: Read the actual source of a node (by label/ID) or a repo-relative file path — the symbol's lines with context. The graph stores only locations, not source text. For a path read, pass start_line to anchor the window anywhere in the file (otherwise it shows the head).

output_format.description: text returns only the concise TextContent summary; json also returns and mirrors the stable structuredContent envelope

name: read_source
